poll_interval.label: Playback polling interval
poll_interval.description: How often playback status is checked, in seconds (1–60).

volume_osd.label: Volume change OSD
volume_osd.description: Show a volume OSD when the connected Cast device's volume changes outside the plugin controls.

track_osd.label: Playback, track, or input change OSD
track_osd.description: Show a media OSD when playback starts or pauses, or when the track or casting input changes outside the plugin controls.
